Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Represents an administrator user in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Admin entity.

email.description: The email address of the administrator.

Principal.title: Principal
Principal.description: Represents a principal user in the system, typically associated with an educational institution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Principal entity.

email.description: The email address of the principal.

schoolName.description: The name of the school the principal is associated with.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student user in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

email.description: The email address of the student.

principalId.description: Reference to the Principal who manages this student.

branch.description: The academic branch or stream of the student (e.g., Computer Science).

Employer.title: Employer
Employer.description: Represents an employer user in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Employer entity.

email.description: The email address of the employer.

Certificate.title: Certificate
Certificate.description: Represents an educational certificate issued to a student. Contains denormalized student data for historical accuracy and easy display.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Certificate entity.

title.description: The title of the certificate (e.g., B.Tech Computer Science).

studentId.description: Reference to the Student to whom the certificate was issued.

principalId.description: Reference to the Principal who issued the certificate.

studentName.description: Denormalized name of the student at the time of issuance.

studentEmail.description: Denormalized email of the student at the time of issuance.

rollNumber.description: Denormalized roll number of the student.

mobileNumber.description: Denormalized mobile number of the student.

branch.description: Denormalized academic branch of the student.

passingYear.description: The year the student passed the course.

passingPercentage.description: The final percentage achieved by the student.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp when the certificate was issued.

hash.description: A cryptographic hash of the certificate data for integrity checking.

blockchainTxId.description: The transaction ID on the blockchain where the certificate hash is anchored.

status.description: The approval status of the certificate, managed by the Admin.

definition.description: Stores student accounts. `principalId` links them to their institution.
Stores certificates. Includes denormalized data for display and historical accuracy.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed for a role-based system. Each user role (Admin, Principal, Student, Employer) has its own top-level collection for clear data separation and security rule simplicity. The `students` collection is now top-level, with a `principalId` field to maintain the link to their institution, which simplifies queries for admins and principals. The `certificates` collection is heavily denormalized, storing a snapshot of student information at the time of issuance. This is critical for historical accuracy and simplifies the verification process, as a certificate document contains all necessary information for display without requiring joins or lookups to the student record.
